text: Figure 7.1: An Application-level Error Manager (ALEM) monitors the health of the sys- tem and initiates recovery actions according to application or OEM-specific recovery policies. This use case is similar to the Fault Management Framework (FMF) developed in the EASIS project [22]. The proposed features in this document have corresponding func- tionalities defined in the FMF . 1The ALEM could also be implemented as a BSW Module, but this is a less flexible solution. This would also entail more effort on specifying an AUTOSAR BSWM for this purpose as well as introducing the notion of a BSW Module that is potentially distributed over several ECUs. This is not within the scope of this concept.
